children: Paid detailed a series of financing actions related to its investment in Embolx, culminating in a letter dated Aug 31, 2026 that extends forbearance through Oct 31, 2026. The relationship began with a secured $1.875 million convertible note in Oct 2022 and was restructured in Mar 2024 with an added $500,000 at a 25% OID and termination of certain warrants. After a default in Jun 2024, the parties entered a forbearance on Jan 31, 2025, extending a $5,967,100 note at 25% interest to Sep 30, 2025, later amended to Aug 31, 2026 and now to Oct 31, 2026. The extensions aim to preserve collateral value and facilitate orderly repayment.
Agreement 1: Paid Enters $1.875 Million Secured Convertible Note Investment in Embolx With 20% OID
: Securities Purchase Agreement for secured convertible note
: Finance investment with collateral and conversion option
Agreement 2: Paid Amends Embolx Note, Adds $500,000 at 25% OID; Certain Warrants Terminated
: Amended and replaced senior secured note with 25% OID
: Restructure defaulted note and provide additional capital
Agreement 3: Paid Enters Forbearance and Loan Modification, Extends $5.97M Embolx Note to Sep 30, 2025
: Forbearance and Loan Modification Agreement (25% interest)
: Provide time for repayment and protect collateral value
Agreement 4: Paid First Amendment Extends Embolx Forbearance Through Aug 31, 2026
: First Amendment to Forbearance and Loan Modification Agreement
: Extend forbearance period to facilitate repayment
Agreement 5: Paid Further Extends Embolx Forbearance to Oct 31, 2026 by Letter Agreement
